nodes.label: Graphify pipeline
nodes.rationale: Graphify turns a folder into a persistent, navigable knowledge graph with HTML, JSON, and a plain-language report.

nodes.label: AST structural extraction
nodes.rationale: Code is extracted deterministically without LLM use, allowing code-only corpora to bypass semantic extraction.

nodes.label: Semantic extraction
nodes.rationale: Documents, papers, and images are semantically extracted through Gemini when configured or through host-agent subagents otherwise.

nodes.label: Graphify watch mode
nodes.rationale: The watcher immediately rebuilds code-only changes but flags document, paper, and image changes for manual semantic re-extraction.

nodes.label: Cross-repository graph merge
nodes.rationale: Separate repository graphs are merged into one graph while retaining a repo attribute on each node for origin filtering.

nodes.label: Graphify post-commit hook
nodes.rationale: The hook performs incremental AST extraction after commits; document and image changes require a manual update.

nodes.label: Constrained query expansion
nodes.rationale: Queries are expanded only with matching tokens from the graph vocabulary to prevent unsupported synonym invention.

nodes.label: Incremental graph update
nodes.rationale: Incremental updates extract changed files, prune only genuinely deleted sources, and preserve the directed-graph setting during merge.

nodes.label: EduHive AI tutor
nodes.rationale: The tutor uses a server-side authenticated chatbot route, limits conversation payloads, validates selected modes, and stores the selected mode with the conversation.
